parameter_policy: Freeze mirror/loss amplitudes 3/5 and 4/5, phases p=q=1, eta=gamma=9/25, initial preparations and operation order before evaluating controls. No per-outcome refitting, new adapters or posterior model repair. These are model fixtures, not measured parameters.

rivals.change: Set returning state to zero whenever reflected amplitude is zero
rivals.control: u=4/5,x=3/5,v=w=0, then vacuum external inputs in next round
rivals.rival: Next reflected amplitude and occupation zero

rivals.change: Drop environment output and claim the remaining three-port map is closed unitary
rivals.control: Unit returning input, other active inputs zero; compare total squared output norm

rivals.change: Exchange W1 after W0 with W0 after W1 without port/time-bin relabelling witness
rivals.shared: Individual round maps and norm preservation
rivals.control: Retained one-photon returning-mode input; compare all labelled two-round output coefficients

rivals.change: Replace retained memory by ready before every bin
rivals.control: Inputs 11 and 101; complete CC and CNC records

rivals.change: Declare memory ready after every no-click
rivals.control: Start with readiness 1/2, photon no-click, then photon click

rivals.change: Keep only first-click trials and report their conditional rates as the full record law
rivals.control: Ready photon; inspect discarded probability mass and record completeness
rivals.rival: Selected first-click frequency 1; selection denominator changes the target

rivals.change: K_I Gamma(W_I), K_I=exp(i*pi*N_I*(N_I-1)/2) per declared round
rivals.shared: Norm, number, vacuum, spectator identity and every total-N<=1 overlap record
rivals.control: Creation covariance on the finite-particle core and the frozen finite-sector field-mean witness

rivals.change: Merge vacuum-ready and vacuum-dead-stay Kraus labels
rivals.shared: CP completeness and all classical-memory sharp-photon histories
rivals.control: No discriminator within charter; coherent-memory X probe is outside charter

rivals.change: Use the same supplied W and Kraus laws in a separately tagged adapter without deriving them from a common native source
rivals.shared: Every supplied-law prediction, including all current model controls
rivals.control: Audit ingredient provenance and actual source-operation comparisons; no output discriminator is claimed
rivals.reference: Conditional construction plus explicit imported ingredients
rivals.rival: Identical numbers with no independent native-source derivation

missing: independent source justification of creation covariance and W
unique detector CP completion beyond classical-memory domain
source_dependence.rule: Successful prediction reuse is not source-law derivation or physical authorization.
